Filter State-wise GST Collection Data

Source: R/collection.R
gst_filter.Rd

Subset gst_statewise by financial year, state, region, component, and/or date range. Returns a data.table.

gst_filter(
  financial_year = NULL,
  state = NULL,
  region = NULL,
  component = NULL,
  from_month = NULL,
  to_month = NULL
)

Arguments

financial_year

character vector of FYs, e.g. "2023-24". NULL = all.

state

character vector of exact state names. NULL = all.

region

character vector: "North", "South", "East", "West", "Central", "Northeast", "Other". NULL = all.

component

character vector from c("cgst","sgst","igst","cess","total"). NULL returns all components.

from_month

character start month "YYYY-MM" (inclusive). NULL = no bound.

to_month

character end month "YYYY-MM" (inclusive). NULL = no bound.

Value

A data.table.

Examples

# South India, FY 2023-24, total only
gst_filter(region = "South", financial_year = "2023-24", component = "total")
